The turtle has a dark, high-domed carapace that appears smooth and slightly glossy. Its head is extended, showing a pointed snout, small lateral eyes, and distinct yellow striping on the neck and side of the head. The front left limb is visible, appearing stout with reddish-orange coloration on the inner thigh/shoulder area. The plastron is partially visible but mostly obscured by the angle and substrate.
